scope: Roadmap milestone steps rehearsed in a disposable local VM, not a real server: Fedora 44 Cloud Base 1.7, 4 vCPU, 6656 MiB, 60 GB virtio disk, user-mode network, the pinned images copied from the workstation (lab/vm-rehearsal.sh --preload-images). The VM stands in for a server until one is bought. A local CA stands in for a public certificate and /etc/hosts for public DNS. Not public networking, not a public certificate, not sustained load, not a seven-day soak.

runs.step: empty-server acceptance, first project and reboot
runs.detail: acceptance 12 of 12 in 91 s, first project 15 of 15, sbarbase.service active after the reboot with its console answering

runs.step: Milestone 1 step 2: pinned console port, TLS proxy as a unit, reboot
runs.detail: console 200 over HTTPS with Strict-Transport-Security before and after the reboot, plain HTTP 308 to https://<host>/, console on the pinned port 8787, then the whole first-project path (15 checks) through the proxy

runs.step: Milestone 5: invitations against the real management Auth
runs.detail: 16 of 16 after the fix below; the first run failed at redeem with 500

runs.step: Milestone 2 acceptance, first half: a backup while two environments serve
runs.detail: 13326 requests through supabase-js and fetch across two environments, 0 failed; the backup of both took about 1 s because the databases are small (about 167 KB each), so this is not a large-database result
PostgREST v14.15 to v14.16 confirmed, a broken version moved back by itself, then a return to the installed pins confirmed; users and identities unchanged at every step

at 6656 MiB the worker's admission refuses the third environment (capacity_exceeded) before the four-environment count guard; the Sbarbase containers used about 258 MiB at rest with two environments, far below what admission reserves

defects_found_and_fixed: the acceptance waited for the console right after installing the unit, before the rehearsal had pulled the images, so an empty host always timed out (fix: the unit is enabled and started after the installation exists)
an image pull was retried once, immediately; a slow link lost the Storage pull twice within seconds (fix: four attempts with 15, 45 and 90 s waits)
redeeming an invitation answered 500: the account calls went to /auth/v1/admin/users on the Auth service itself, which serves /admin/users (fix: the calls use Auth's own paths)
the first upgrade after an acceptance was refused as local changes, because the acceptance rewrites tracked evidence (fix: evidence is copied aside to .lab/upgrades/ and never blocks)
a systemd unit that executes bun under /home fails on Fedora with SELinux (status 203/EXEC); the rehearsal's TLS unit starts it through /bin/sh
findings_not_code: after an automatic way back, lab/upgrade.py rollback has nothing to roll back; returning to earlier pins is an upgrade to the earlier version
the TLS proxy redirects plain HTTP to https://<public host>/ on port 443, as a public server needs
